claims.summary: The same ZIP showed 55 atom sourceRefs covered through one CourseIR source row while nine trusted external source rows were exported beside it.
The source-ledger grader now emits a P1 when complete-looking atom sourceRef coverage is not wired to exported trusted source ledger rows.
The patch does not invent licenses, change source scoring, or treat review-only CourseIR rows as trusted bibliography.
